about.label: About us
about.text1: Uniprix Investment is a Construction and Project management company specializing in project Planning, Construction, Interior designs, and Renovation and Property management services.
about.text2: We believe every successful Construction project starts with proper planning from Site Visits, Project designs to construction, focusing on Accuracy, Quality control, Efficient and Execution at every stage.
about.imageAlt: Architect drawing blueprints with a compass

items.title: Project Planning & Management
items.description: We handle the planning, coordination, and control of your project from start to finish. Our structured approach ensures clear timelines, controlled costs, and smooth execution at every stage.

items.title: Construction & Site Supervision
items.description: We provide hands-on site supervision to ensure construction is carried out according to approved designs, quality standards, and safety requirements.

items.title: Interior Design
items.description: We design functional, comfortable, and modern interior spaces that reflect your lifestyle and purpose. Every detail is planned to balance aesthetics and practicality.

items.title: Renovation & Remodeling
items.description: We help upgrade, redesign, or improve existing spaces while maintaining structural integrity and enhancing value.

whyChooseUs.label: Why Choose Us
whyChooseUs.subtitle: Choosing the right partner makes all the difference. We combine proper planning, hands-on supervision, and clear communication to deliver projects with confidence and quality.
whyChooseUs.imageAlt: Person signing construction documents on clipboard

features.title: Structured Project Planning
features.description: We design every project carefully to avoid delays, reduce risks, and ensure smooth execution.

features.title: Hands-On Site Supervision
features.description: Our technical team is actively involved on site, ensuring proper standards, and timelines are followed.

features.title: Quality-Focused Execution
features.description: We prioritize durability, functionality, and attention to detail at every stage of construction and design.

features.title: Transparent Process
features.description: Clear communication, defined scopes, and professional coordination to keep clients informed and confident.

features.title: Client-Centred Approach
features.description: We listen, advise honestly, and tailor solutions to match your goals, budget, and long-term vision.
